run_pipeline_sana_controlnet: run the SanaControlNetPipeline __call__ method to generate images from a text prompt and control image
encode_prompt: encode a text prompt into Gemma transformer hidden state embeddings with attention mask for Sana image generation
prepare_control_image: prepare a control image by preprocessing, encoding through VAE, and scaling latent conditioning for Sana ControlNet
prepare_latents: prepare random Gaussian latents with specified batch size, channels, height, width, dtype and device for diffusion
retrieve_timesteps: retrieve scheduler timesteps from set_timesteps method supporting custom timesteps, sigmas, or num_inference_steps
